scope: Feature audit, no product changes or remote mutations

remoteReadOnlyObservation.query: select 'team_accounts' as feature, count(*)::int as total from private.product_staff union all select 'calendar_connections', count(*)::int from private.calendar_links union all select 'push_devices', count(*)::int from private.push_devices union all select 'push_outbox', count(*)::int from private.push_outbox;
